HubSpot Property Health Audit - Golden Page 2

HubSpot Property Health Audit - Golden
Method & how to read the workbook
What "used" means
Two signals decide a custom property's rating: Fill % (the share of a sampled batch of records that have a value set)
and Uses (the number of this portal's workflows whose actions reference the property). This tool is read-only and only
pulls workflows - forms, lists, reports, and dashboards aren't read, so Uses can undercount a property that's only
referenced there. Native HubSpot properties are always Keep; only custom properties are ever flagged.
Rating rules
- Remove candidate - custom, under 5% filled, referenced by no workflow.
- Review - custom, and either (a) referenced by a workflow but under 25% filled, or (b) 5%+ filled but referenced by no
workflow.
- Keep - native property (always), or custom with 25%+ fill and at least one workflow reference.
Workbook tabs
- Summary - per-object counts and cleanup score, worst-first.
- All Properties - every one of the 3 properties, one row each, with blank Notes/Tag columns to fill in.
- Flagged for Action - the 2 custom properties rated Remove candidate or Review, worst first.
